opportunity.title: IBM Mainframes and Maintenance for the FDIC
opportunity.description: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation requests quotes under RFQ CORHQ-26-Q-0388 for new IBM mainframes and maintenance. Offerors must complete the price schedule. Terms and conditions, EULA or MSAs must accompany the quote; FDIC prefers government-approved terms. Quotes need a letter of authorization from the manufacturer and, if applicable, a proposed GSA Schedule or NASA SEWP contract. Questions were due Oct 9, 2026; quotes are due Oct 22, 2026. IBM site numbers for FDIC are 5166681 (VASQ) and 4742836 (DFW/BDC).

profile._note: FICTIONAL SAMPLE COMPANY for scenario testing. Not a real firm. Past performance and staffing are invented; only the NAICS codes, set-aside definitions and every opportunity and award figure used against it are real public data.
profile.name: Atlas Federal Systems Inc. (sample)
profile.pastPerformance: Large business. Eleven DoD and civilian IT prime contracts between $5M and $60M, including a Defense Health Agency data program.
profile.capacityNotes: About 400 staff, 150 cleared. Facility clearance (Top Secret). FedRAMP Moderate. Not eligible for any set-aside.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

checks.reason: Full and open competition; no set-aside required.
NAICS 541519 is in the company's codes.

supportedClaims.text: The FDIC solicitation CORHQ-26-Q-0388 seeks new IBM mainframes and maintenance services for its Arlington, Virginia location.
The solicitation is open to small business concerns without any set-aside preference.
The requirement specifies IBM site numbers VASQ (5166681) and DFW/BDC (4742836).
Questions are due by 12:00 PM EST on October 9, 2026, and quotes are due by 12:00 PM EST on October 20, 2026.

rationale.point: Atlas Federal Systems is a large business with NAICS 541519 matching the opportunity and a facility clearance (Top Secret) that supports work at the Arlington, VA location specified in the solicitation.
The solicitation is open to small business concerns without a set-aside preference, meaning large businesses like Atlas are eligible to compete (eligibility gate passed).
The requirement calls out specific IBM site numbers (VASQ and DFW/BDC); Atlas must demonstrate or acquire the ability to service those configurations.
The quote deadline is October 20, 2026, with questions due October 9, 2026, giving a tight but manageable window for proposal preparation.

risks: No prior FDIC contract awards in NAICS 541519 in the last five years, indicating limited agency relationship or track record in this specific domain.

Atlas's past performance emphasizes DoD/civilian IT prime contracts and a Defense Health Agency data program, but does not explicitly cite IBM mainframe hardware procurement or maintenance experience.
As a large business, Atlas may face price or evaluation pressure from small business competitors in a procurement that explicitly notes openness to small business concerns.
nextSteps: Verify internal IBM mainframe installation/maintenance capabilities or identify a qualified teaming partner (e.g., IBM authorized reseller/maintainer).
Submit any clarifying questions by the October 9, 2026 deadline to resolve site-specific requirements.
Prepare a quote addressing the two IBM site numbers (VASQ 5166681 and DFW/BDC 4742836) and leveraging Atlas's FedRAMP Moderate authorization and Top Secret facility clearance.
Conduct a bid/no-bid review after question responses are received and capability gaps are assessed.
